name: Choice Chews | 200mg Gummies | Super Sour Prickly Pear
description: What better way to invigorate your senses than with the unique flavor of Choice Chews' Sour Prickly Pear gummies! We captured the tangy essence of prickly pear and amplified it with a hint of sourness, all while boosting it with the uplifting power of sativa for a refreshing and energizing experience.
